Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
Vehicle
public class Vehicle extends Object
Represents a single vehicle in the traffic simulation.

Each vehicle has:

  • Unique identifier determining its type (car, truck, bus, motorcycle, emergency)
  • Position and orientation in world coordinates
  • Type-specific dimensions and visual appearance
  • Signal state (turn signals, brake lights, emergency flashers)

The vehicle type is automatically determined from its ID prefix:

  • "car" → Passenger car (4.5m × 1.8m)
  • "truck" → Truck (8.0m × 2.5m)
  • "bus" → Bus (10.0m × 2.5m)
  • "moto" → Motorcycle (2.0m × 0.8m)
  • "ambu" → Emergency vehicle (6.0m × 2.5m)

  • Constructor Details

    • Vehicle

      public Vehicle(String id, double worldX, double worldY, double angle)
      Constructs a new vehicle with the specified position and orientation. The vehicle type and dimensions are automatically determined from the ID prefix.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique vehicle identifier (prefix determines type)
      worldX - The X coordinate in world space (meters)
      worldY - The Y coordinate in world space (meters)
      angle - The orientation angle in degrees (0 = east, 90 = north)

  • Method Details

    • updatePosition

      public void updatePosition(double[] sumoData)
      Updates the vehicle's position, angle, and signal state from SUMO data.
      Parameters:
      sumoData - Array containing [x, y, angle, signals] where: x, y are world coordinates in meters, angle is in degrees (SUMO format), signals is a bit field for turn signals and brake lights

    • contains

      public boolean contains(double screenX, double screenY, CoordinateTransform transform)
      Checks if a screen point falls within the vehicle's clickable area. Uses circular hit detection for better user interaction.
      Parameters:
      screenX - The X coordinate in screen space
      screenY - The Y coordinate in screen space
      transform - The coordinate transformation
      Returns:
      true if the point is within the vehicle's clickable radius

    • highlight

      public void highlight(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext g, CoordinateTransform transform, javafx.scene.paint.Color color)
      Draws a dashed rectangle outline around the vehicle when selected or hovered.
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context to draw on
      transform - The coordinate transformation
      color - The highlight color

    • render

      public void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext g, CoordinateTransform transform)
      Renders the vehicle with proper body, windshield, headlights, and signal indicators. The vehicle is drawn with its front at (worldX, worldY) extending backward.
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context to draw on
      transform - The coordinate transformation
